mapper.select: SELECT no, enrollment_no, video_no, current_time AS currentTime, duration, progress, completed, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM course_video_progress WHERE enrollment_no=#{enrollment_no}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO course_video_progress p USING( SELECT #{enrollment_no} AS enrollment_no, #{video_no} AS video_no FROM dual ) s ON( p.enrollment_no=s.enrollment_no AND p.video_no=s.video_no ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET p.current_time=#{currentTime}, p.duration=#{duration}, p.progress=GREATEST( NVL(p.progress,0), #{progress} ), p.completed= CASE WHEN p.completed='Y' OR #{completed}='Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, p.updated_at=SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT( enrollment_no, video_no, current_time, duration, progress, completed, updated_at ) VALUES( #{enrollment_no}, #{video_no}, #{currentTime}, #{duration}, #{progress}, #{completed}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_video cv JOIN course_enrollment ce ON cv.course_no=ce.course_no WHERE ce.no=#{enrollment_no}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_video_progress WHERE enrollment_no=#{enrollment_no} AND completed='Y'
